e01.saheli: Good morning Indira ji, wonderful to hear you've taken your Donepezil. Wishing you a peaceful and bright day ahead!
e01.text: Good morning beta! Just wanted to tell you that I have taken my Donepezil medicine on time after my morning tea. Hope you are also having a lovely day.

e02.saheli: Hello Indira ji! 127/77 is a very good reading, thank you for sharing. Glad to know you are feeling well today.
e02.text: Hello dear! I just checked my blood pressure now and the reading is 127/77. Everything feels quite fine and steady today.

e03.saheli: Please rest comfortably and sip some warm water, Indira ji. Do let Tanya know right away so she can check on you.
e03.text: Beta, I am not feeling very well today. I have been running a fever since this afternoon, and when I checked just now it was 100.8.

e04.saheli: Good morning! An evening walk at 6:30 pm sounds lovely and refreshing, Indira ji. Do wear comfortable shoes and take it easy.
e04.text: Good morning Saheli! I have decided that from tomorrow, I will go for an evening walk every day at 6:30 pm. A little fresh air will do me a lot of good.

e05.saheli: Festivals bring such warmth and sweet memories, Indira ji! It is wonderful to soak in that festive spirit and excitement.
e05.text: You know beta, the festival season is just around the corner and the house already feels so lively! I was remembering how we used to start preparations weeks in advance with sweets and decorations.

h001.saheli: Understood Tanya, I have noted Aai's details and medicine schedule carefully. I am here whenever she or you need anything.
h001.text: Please set up Saheli for Indira. Conditions Early dementia, Type 2 diabetes. Medicine Donepezil 5 mg at 22:00. Allergy eggs. Doctor Dr Natasha Bose. Call her Aai.

h002.saheli: Good morning Indira ji, starting the morning with path brings such wonderful peace. Wishing you a blessed day ahead!
h002.text: Good morning Saheli, today I finished my morning path very peacefully. It always brings such quiet to my mind before the day begins. How are you doing today?

h003.saheli: Noted Tanya, thanks for letting me know.

h004.saheli: Indira ji, it is always safest to take medicines with plain water, as tea can sometimes affect how medicines work. If in doubt, Dr Natasha Bose can give you clear guidance.
h004.text: Beta Saheli, I was having my morning cup of chai and wondered if I can just swallow my tablet with it? Or should I strictly take water only?

h005.saheli: Please do take some proper rest and lie down, Indira ji. Listen to your body and keep a glass of water nearby.
h005.text: I am feeling quite tired today beta, my limbs just feel so heavy this afternoon. I think I will lie down for a little while and rest.

h006.saheli: That is so sweet, old school friendships are truly special. It must brighten Aai's Sundays to catch up with Kishore!
h006.text: Aai's school friend Kishore calls on Sundays.

h007.saheli: Thank you for the update Indira ji, but please do remember that Donepezil is scheduled for 22:00 at night. Do check with Tanya or Dr Natasha Bose so we keep to the right timing.
h007.text: Saheli beta, just wanted to let you know that I took my Donepezil after breakfast today with some water. The day has been quite pleasant so far.

h008.saheli: It is always nice to have good neighbours dropping by for a chat.

h009.saheli: Thanks for flagging this Tanya. Just a reminder that her Donepezil 5 mg is scheduled for 22:00, so please check with Dr Natasha Bose about adjusting today's dose.

h010.saheli: Aai has Donepezil 5 mg scheduled for 22:00 tonight.

h011.saheli: Sounds comforting and delicious for lunch!

h012.saheli: So glad to hear that, Tanya. A good night's sleep makes all the difference.

h013.saheli: Thank you for letting me know, Tanya. Hope it is helping Aai breathe comfortably.
h013.text: Aai took Budesonide-Formoterol inhaler after breakfast.

h014.saheli: Rameswaram is such a beautiful and sacred place. A family trip there will be wonderful for Aai!

h015.saheli: The house must be lively and full of energy with the little ones around!

h016.saheli: Noted Tanya, I have added Budesonide-Formoterol inhaler 2 puffs at 08:30 and 22:00 to Aai's schedule. Take care, and let Dr Natasha Bose know if her breathing needs attention.
h016.text: Tests back. Indira has COPD / asthma. Dr started Budesonide-Formoterol inhaler 2 puffs at 08:30, 22:00.

h017.saheli: How lovely, Dev's birthday will be here soon! Aai must be looking forward to celebrating her grandchild's special day.

h018.saheli: Good morning Indira ji! It is wonderful that you enjoyed your morning walk in the fresh air. Keep up this healthy routine!
h018.text: Good morning Saheli, I went down to the compound and finished my morning walk properly. The fresh air was so refreshing today, and I saw a few birds in the garden.

h019.saheli: Good evening Indira ji! Tonight at 22:00, you have Donepezil 5 mg and 2 puffs of your Budesonide-Formoterol inhaler scheduled.
h019.text: Good evening beta, could you please remind me what medicines are due for me this evening? Sometimes I forget the night routine.

h020.saheli: Wonderful start to the day for Aai!

h021.saheli: K. J. Yesudas has such a soothing, divine voice, Indira ji. Listening to his melodies in the evening is truly a wonderful way to relax!
h021.text: Saheli beta, you know I love old songs by K. J. Yesudas so much, I listen every evening without fail. His voice brings such a deep feeling of calm to my heart.

h022.saheli: I am sorry you are feeling low today, Indira ji. Please be gentle with yourself, perhaps listen to your favourite songs or have a warm cup of tea.
h022.text: I am feeling a bit low today beta, just not very cheerful for some reason. Days like this happen sometimes, but I am sitting quietly by the window.

h023.saheli: Fresh tomato rasam smells and tastes so comforting, Indira ji! It is always wonderful when cooking brings so much joy.
h023.text: I prepared some lovely tomato rasam today Saheli, the whole kitchen was smelling of roasted cumin and curry leaves. Cooking simple home food always gives me such happiness.

h024.saheli: Stay warm and cosy indoors, Tanya!

h025.saheli: Nothing compares to the joy grandchildren bring, Indira ji! Their laughter and creativity truly brighten up the entire home.
h025.text: Beta, the grandchildren were playing and laughing so much today, showing me all their drawings. My heart just feels completely full whenever they are around me.

h026.saheli: It is lovely that Aai has her favourite 9 pm serial to look forward to every night! Having that enjoyable routine is so nice.
h026.text: Aai watches Pyaar Ka Rishta at 9 pm daily.

h027.saheli: Good to know Tanya, regular morning walks do so much good.

h028.saheli: Noted Tanya, that diastolic reading of 97 is on the higher side. Please have Aai rest quietly, and consider checking in with Dr Natasha Bose if it stays up.

h029.saheli: Good afternoon Indira ji! That quiet devotional time brings so much inner strength and calm to the day.
h029.text: Good afternoon beta Saheli, I have completed my path and recitation peacefully today. It always gives me a feeling that everything will be well.

h030.saheli: Good morning Indira ji, thank you for letting me know, but please remember Donepezil is meant for 22:00 at night. Do inform Tanya so she can check the timing with Dr Natasha Bose.
h030.text: Good morning Saheli, I just finished my breakfast and took my Donepezil tablet right after. Hoping the rest of the day goes smoothly too.

h031.saheli: Good evening Indira ji! Glad to hear you took it on time and are feeling comfortable.
h031.text: Good evening Saheli, just wanted to let you know that I took my Budesonide-Formoterol inhaler right after breakfast today. Feeling quite fine and comfortable now.

h032.saheli: Good morning Indira ji! That is wonderful to hear, nothing beats a refreshing morning stroll.
h032.text: Good morning dear! Just finished my morning walk around the colony park, the fresh air was really wonderful today.

h034.saheli: Let me check the records and get back to you shortly, Tanya.

z01.saheli: I don't have the current dose of Donepezil noted down. Please check her prescription or medicine strip to be sure.
z01.text: What dose of Donepezil does mom take now?

z02.saheli: I don't have any allergies recorded for Indira ji. It's best to check her medical file or consult her doctor.

z03.saheli: I don't have her doctor's name on record right now. You might want to check her recent clinic slips.

z04.saheli: I don't have her complete current medicine list with me. Please check her daily pillbox or prescription.
z04.text: How many regular medicines does mom take now?

z05.saheli: I don't have Indira ji's test results from this month. Please check with her doctor or lab reports.
z05.text: What did mom's tests show this month?

z06.saheli: I'm not sure who calls her on Sundays. Indira ji will be happy to tell you herself!

z07.saheli: I don't have any details about your upcoming family trip. Where are you thinking of taking her?
z07.text: Where is family planning to go next month?

z08.saheli: I don't have Dev's birthday noted down. Let me know the date so I can remember!

z09.saheli: I don't have her favourite singer saved yet. Tell me what she loves listening to!

z10.saheli: I don't know which 9 pm serial she follows. You can ask her what she's watching tonight!
z10.text: Which serial does mom watch at 9 pm?
